title: August 2026 closure production - batch H6, the two genuine new roots from the 31-August LPG-carrier report (Snapshot 03)
note: TWO CARDS, NOT FIVE. The Founder brief that opened this batch named five asks. Three of them - AUG-0095 freedom of navigation, AUG-0140 crew entitlements onboard, AUG-0148 grain loading booklet - carry classification GENUINE_NEW_QUESTION in AUGUST2026_INTAKE_ADJUDICATIONS.json, and the brief read that field as the work order. It is not: classification is frozen at INTAKE and answers only 'did a matching card exist when this ask was first scored'. The DISPOSITION lives in AUGUST2026_PRODUCTION_QUEUE.json under production_outcomes.H3A, written after the reuse-first pass and after independent review, and it disposed of all three WITHOUT a new card. Each was re-verified here against the live card BODY, not against the summary: QB1_A#q19 carries the UNCLOS zones and, since CORR-UNCLOS-FREEDOM-20260831, the Art. 58(3) and Art. 87(2) 'due regard' condition that AUG-0096 asked for; QB9_H#q10 carries the Seafarer Employment Agreement under MLC Std A2.1, the copy carried onboard with any CBA incorporated and available to PSC in English, and the Std A2.2 wage accounts; QB2_A#q11 states that the Document of Authorisation is invalid unless accompanied by an approved Grain Stability Booklet, describes its contents, and carries the three post-MSC.552(108) loading configurations. Building standalone roots for those three would have created DUPLICATE ROOTS against live cards and, for AUG-0095, would have contradicted a correction that had already shipped to answer that exact limb. The Founder ruled on 2026-09-02 that the dispositions stand. Recorded as known_traps entry 63 so the next reader of the adjudication file does not repeat it. NO EXAMINER ATTRIBUTION WAS MINTED. Both occurrences are PANEL_LEVEL_ONLY (Nair external, Srivastava internal): neither card carries a data-examiner attribute, neither CE Oral Tip names an individual, and no STRONG_CE_TIP_REVIEW decision row was added. build_examiner_index reports 958 relationships across 7 examiners, tier-for-tier identical to the pre-batch snapshot. NO UNIVERSAL THRESHOLD WAS INVENTED. The AUG-0266 card is explicit that deviation and alarm bands are the engine maker's and the ship's, not a remembered percentage, and its Numbers deep-dive says so in terms; the only figures it fixes are the ISO ones already carried by its sibling QB5_J#q1.
examiner_relationship_delta_note: Zero by construction, not by luck. The examiner index is built from committed evidence records (RELEASE_A_PUBLICATION.json, STRONG_CE_TIP_REVIEW_DECISIONS.json) and from data-examiner attributes on q-cards. Neither new card carries that attribute and no decision row was added, so a new card cannot mint a relationship. PANEL_LEVEL_ONLY attribution in the intake record is exactly why that was the correct construction.

cards.topic: How a Chief Engineer decides the main engine is underperforming - performance as a COMPARISON against the shop-trial and sea-trial baseline, correction to ISO 3046-1 reference conditions and reference LCV 42,700 kJ/kg, elimination of hull, propeller, weather and draught via ISO 19030, then the engine's own parameters (fuel index at given power, Pcomp/Pmax from indicator or draw cards, exhaust deviation from mean, scavenge pressure and temperature, turbocharger speed READ WITH scavenge pressure, back pressure, corrected SFOC and slip), cylinder-versus-system localisation, and a confirmation sequence that suspects the instrument before the engine and checks for a limiter before declaring a fault
cards.placement_rationale: QB5_J.html is titled 'Main Engine, Fuel & Turbocharger' and is the topic owner. Its only existing card, QB5_J#q1, is Lower Calorific Value and why engine performance is quoted against LCV - which is precisely the normalisation basis this card depends on, and the card cross-references it. No new file was created; the adjudication's own production_note named QB5_C_A#q3 and QB5_J#q1 as the adjacent material, and QB5_C_A#q3 was rejected in that adjudication as a VOYAGE performance card that never sets out how the engine itself is judged.
cards.examiner_attribution: PANEL_LEVEL_ONLY - no data-examiner attribute, no named examiner in the CE Oral Tip, no Examiner Chain deep-dive.

cards.topic: The Chief Engineer's responsibility for engine-room spares and stores inventory - the critical-spares list DERIVED from the ISM 10.3 critical-equipment list rather than chosen, ISM 10.4 stand-by arrangements, minimum stock and reorder point from consumption and lead time, the prescribed stock that carries a number (SOLAS II-2 Reg. 10.3.3 extinguisher spare charges and class-required spares for essential services), record-truth discipline, five named failure modes, and the leadership limb the panel pressed - delegation with defined authority under ISM 3.2, ownership, verification by sampling rather than counting, and ISM 9 escalation when a critical spare is refused
cards.placement_rationale: QB5_I.html is 'Management, Leadership & Human Element' and carries the broadest tag set in the QB5 management family (human-element, iacs, ism, management, mlc, solas, stcw). It already holds QB5_I#q4 'CE as leader vs manager', which is the card the leadership limb of this ask chains to. QB5_G was rejected as an undifferentiated 'Additional Questions' file and QB5_D/QB5_H duplicate the leader question rather than owning management systems. No new file was created.
cards.examiner_attribution: PANEL_LEVEL_ONLY - no data-examiner attribute, no named examiner in the CE Oral Tip, no Examiner Chain deep-dive.
